text: Each promotion has an **Item Description** that is used as the Order Item Description when the promotion is applied. Each promotion also has a **Service** which defines the behavior of the promotion. Each promotion Service has parameters you can use to adjust behavior. There are a few standard promotion services to choose from and your system may have additional custom promotion services available.
